key_idea: The main result is proved by integrating a sharp lower bound on the entropy production, which is established via dimension induction using an elaborately engineered surrogate profile to patch various analytical cases.
reason: The proof successfully establishes a sharp result but buries its underlying intuition under a massive chain of calculus lemmas, localized geometric estimates, and dense technical bookkeeping. Its heavy reliance on manual analytical grinding and extensive case-splitting severely detracts from its overall elegance.
